key_insight: Unified factored organizers (UFOs) learn regularities in another network’s representations and guide it toward more coherent structure, rather than low task loss alone.
engineering_relevance: UFO regularization may inform representation learning in engineering models, but this paper does not demonstrate solid-mechanics or fracture applications.
method: Train a UFO to model regularities in another network’s representations.
Train the task network for both task accuracy and alignment with the UFO.
Evaluate interpretable image regression and transformer modular-arithmetic grokking.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports qualitatively improved image-regression representations and over 10× fewer transformer steps to grok versus weight decay alone, or over 100× fewer versus an unregularized baseline without weight decay.
watch_item: Results are limited to the reported domains; transfer to mechanics tasks and total computational overhead remain unestablished.
paper_title: Are UFOs Real? Introducing Unified Factored Organizers
